requirements.text: The evaluator MUST derive stateful validity for every retained otherwise-usable control against that control's own branch; static usability alone MUST NOT establish noncanonical validity.
Each child base head MUST be resolved against accepted state under the child's actual parent branch, preserving pending and invalid distinctions.
Evaluation of one coordinate MUST NOT traverse or charge change claims attributable only to another coordinate, even when a foreign claim names a target control or shares a change hash.
A target descriptor MUST be joined only with chunks attributable to the target coordinate.
Foreign evidence MUST NOT enter target event dispositions, digest inputs, completion decisions, or target-proportional work counters.
Propagation of pending or invalid parent state MUST visit each relevant control relationship through a deterministic charged traversal and observe cancellation before target-proportional work.
Every reserved finalization dimension MUST be settled exactly once as actual consumption, validated refund, or deliberate interruption forfeiture; generic remainder erasure is forbidden.
The externally authored NIP SHOULD eventually reconcile all interoperability-critical companion rules without changing provisional allocation boundaries.
Conforming engines MUST process the checksum-bound v8 distribution of exactly 171 scenarios under every required delivery permutation.
Each of the 129 registry rows MUST bind exact candidate identities, source assertions, fixtures where applicable, and artifact hashes; weakening evidence binding MUST be rejected.
